name: nginx-multisite
description: Manages an Nginx reverse proxy and web server for three virtual hosts, including static content, HTTPS, development certificates, firewall hardening, Fail2ban, sysctl settings, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and generated-configuration cleanup.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a FastAPI application from GitHub with Python dependencies, a virtual environment, local PostgreSQL database and credentials, environment configuration, and a systemd/Uvicorn service on port 8000.
